image_description: Two cloth diapers (reusable nappies) placed side-by-side on a textured, brownish-yellow floral or leaf-patterned surface. The left diaper is light blue/teal with white polka dots and snap fasteners. The right diaper is a slightly darker blue with similar white snap fasteners and elasticized leg openings. Both appear to be modern pocket-style or all-in-one cloth diapers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular when flat, with elasticized leg openings and waistband.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The items clearly exhibit the characteristic shape of cloth diapers with visible elastic gathering at the leg holes and waist area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thickness is notably padded and bulky when uncompressed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The diapers show significant volume and puffiness, consistent with absorbent padding layers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Folded form shows layered construction with absorbent core between layers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The internal layered construction of the absorbent core is not visible as the diapers are closed/assembled.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Fastening system uses adhesive tabs (hook-and-loop or sticky) on side panels.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: White circular snap fasteners are clearly visible on the front panels of both diapers, serving the same function as adhesive tabs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elastic creates gathered ruffles at leg cuffs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct ruffling/gathering caused by elastic is visible around the leg openings of both diapers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Size indicators and wetness strip may be visible.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No specific size tags or color-changing wetness indicator strips are visible on the exterior surfaces shown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Outer surface is smooth plastic or fabric-like material in white or printed patterns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The outer layer appears to be a soft fabric (likely PUL or cotton) with a polka dot pattern on the left and solid color on the right.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Inner surface is soft non-woven fabric.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The inner lining is completely occluded by the closed structure of the diapers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Absorbent padded core with waterproof outer layer.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While implied by the bulk, the specific materials (core vs. waterproof layer) cannot be visually distinguished without cross-section visibility.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The background texture has a slightly repetitive, 'mushy' quality typical of AI-generated patterns, lacking distinct high-frequency detail in the floral/leaf motifs.
The white strap/tab hanging off the bottom right of the left diaper appears to merge slightly into the background and lacks clear structural definition or thickness.
The circular snaps on the right diaper are slightly elliptical and inconsistent in perspective alignment relative to the curved surface of the diaper.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific sub-type of diaper (cloth/reusable vs. disposable) and verify class alignment.
To check for edge bleeding between the diapers and the complex background, and ensure the snaps are topologically connected to the fabric.
To assess the realism of the fabric textures and lighting consistency across the scene.

focus_areas: Snap fastener geometry and attachment points
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the elastic ruffles and the main body of the diaper. AI often struggles to render the tension of elastic correctly, resulting in 'melting' or unnatural smoothing. Also, verify if the shadows cast by the diapers onto the textured background are consistent with a single light source.
